# The  Element

The element in HTML is used to define the title of a creative work (e.g., a book, article, song, movie, painting, sculpture, etc.). It's typically used to provide a reference or citation for a source. The content inside the element is often rendered in italics by browsers, but this styling can be overridden with CSS. Visit the following resources to learn more:
